phases.name: Foundation
phases.goal: A Hugo site styled like eltonminetto.dev is live on a staging subdomain with bilingual scaffolding, home, about, and 404 pages.
successCriteria: Staging subdomain serves a single-column, sans-serif, light-background Hugo site inspired by eltonminetto.dev.
Hugo native i18n is configured with content/pt-br and content/en and a visible language switcher.
Home and About render in both languages.
The switcher shows an only-in-PT/EN badge when a translation is missing instead of hiding or redirecting away.

creates.description: Hugo site configuration — bilingual pt-BR/en, PaperMod theme, minimal single-column aesthetic
Netlify build + per-context environment — pinned Hugo 0.170.1, context-aware baseURL, submodule checkout
Bilingual language switcher with orphan-aware only-in-X badge

phases.name: Content Migration
phases.goal: Every WordPress post, page, and image is versioned in the Hugo repo and renders on staging, including Recomendacoes sub-pages and the TCC/ClassGenerator pair.
successCriteria: All WordPress posts are converted to Markdown with front-matter (title, date, tags, language) under content//posts/.
All WordPress media is downloaded and versioned under static/images/ and referenced from Markdown.
Recomendacoes renders with sub-pages for Books/Cafes, Kitesurf, Musica, Sites e Podcasts, Posts Especiais, and Arte em SP where content exists.
TCC/ClassGenerator exists in both PT and EN variants as standalone pages.

creates.description: 107 WordPress posts migrated to Hugo page bundles — 103 PT + 4 EN, bilingual
134 WordPress media assets migrated (HEIC to JPEG, VideoPress self-hosted, images under year/month paths)
Recomendacoes PT branch bundle with 9 sub-pages
TCC PT page with EN pair via shared translationKey
WordPress to Hugo conversion script reusable by Phase 2.2+

needs.description: Hugo site configuration — bilingual pt-BR/en, PaperMod theme, minimal single-column aesthetic

phases.name: Pending Tech Fixes
phases.goal: Technical debt from Phase 2 migration is resolved — the 139MB video self-hosted on YouTube, broken VideoPress embeds replaced, external images no longer proxied through Jetpack, and GitHub pushes auto-deploy via Netlify without manual CLI.
successCriteria: The 139MB video (static/videos/20250201095728000070.mp4) is published on a YouTube channel owned by the site owner and referenced via a YouTube iframe embed in its originating post.
Every WordPress post that originally embedded a VideoPress iframe either plays a self-hosted video or embeds a YouTube video — with no empty iframe divs remaining.
External images proxied through i0.wp.com (Giphy, Medium, softwarelivre.org and similar) are either downloaded and self-hosted or replaced with direct source URLs.
Pushing to main on github.com/marcelioleal/newsite triggers an automatic Netlify production deploy without a manual netlify deploy invocation.

creates.description: VideoPress iframe swap script — replaced 8 empty figures with  tags across 3 posts; also deleted orphan 139MB video
Jetpack CDN proxy cleanup — downloaded 74 archivable external images, removed 88 dead-tag references; zero Jetpack externals remain

phases.name: Design Polish (dark-default theme)
phases.goal: The site ships with a dark theme by default and a light toggle, extending the Phase 1 minimal single-column aesthetic into a cohesive dark palette.
successCriteria: disableThemeToggle in hugo.toml [params] is set to false, exposing PaperMod's theme toggle in the header.
defaultTheme in hugo.toml [params] is set to dark.
assets/css/extended/custom.css defines a dark palette (background, foreground, muted, accent) that preserves the ~720px single-column layout, system font stack, and dates-above-titles typography.
The language switcher aria-disabled badge and the dated post-list both maintain WCAG AA contrast (ratio at or above 4.5:1) in dark mode.
static/og-default.png and static/favicon.ico are regenerated or validated for dark-default rendering.

creates.description: Extended CSS with a dark-default palette and a light override triggered by PaperMod data-theme attribute

needs.description: Hugo config with Phase 1 aesthetic params that this phase amends (disableThemeToggle=false, defaultTheme=dark)

phases.name: Features — Search, RSS, Analytics
phases.goal: The site has static search, discoverable RSS feeds, and privacy-friendly analytics that count both humans and bot traffic — all free or near-free, no cookie banner, GDPR-safe.
successCriteria: Pagefind is wired into the Hugo build; a search field in the header returns ranked results across all posts and pages.
An RSS link is visible in the header or footer pointing at /index.xml (PT) and /en/index.xml (EN).
GoatCounter free tier is wired via a small inline script in layouts/partials/extend_head.html; visits are visible on the GoatCounter dashboard, including bot classifications.
The analytics script loads only in production/staging (not local dev) and respects Do-Not-Track.
CSP in static/_headers is updated to allow the GoatCounter script origin without compromising the strict baseline.

creates.description: Pagefind static search index built at Hugo build time and served from /pagefind/
GoatCounter analytics script in layouts/partials/extend_head.html with bot visibility

needs.description: Head partial from Phase 1 where the analytics script and search toggle land

phases.name: SEO Preservation and Cutover
phases.goal: marcelioleal.com serves the Hugo site without breaking inbound links and WordPress is decommissioned.
successCriteria: Every WordPress post URL is either preserved as the same slug on Hugo or served via a 301 redirect.
A Netlify _redirects file covers every slug change and is verified end-to-end with a crawler.
DNS of marcelioleal.com points at Netlify production and WordPress is turned off.
Google Search Console reports no new 404 errors after the cutover window.

creates.description: Netlify _redirects file mapping legacy WordPress URLs to Hugo URLs
Production deployment serving marcelioleal.com with WordPress decommissioned
